title: Store Update 2.2.0
body:
# Store Update 2.2.0

Raiders!

Update 2.2 is now live and brings the Wreck Set along with a range of fixes. Restart your game to download it. The PvE Beta test has now concluded, and we hope many of you got a chance to try it out.

We want to hear your impressions. How did the PvE experience compare with your normal playthroughs? What should be improved? And did the usual PvPvE feel different during the test period? Post your feedback in the dedicated PvE feedback channel on Discord.

Starting October 22nd, we will also send a survey to a representative sample of ARC Raiders players, so watch your inbox for it.

# Content and Bug Fixes

# Animation

General

* Fixed an issue where wind animations failed to play on the Frigate.

* Fixed an issue where the Vault Spring jump animation sometimes did not trigger.

* Fixed an issue where Selfie Emotes could look distorted while the player was moving.

Grappling Hook

* Fixed an issue where switching weapons right after throwing the Grappling Hook could break weapon animations.

* Refined the climbing rope swing animations so transitions when climbing up and jumping off feel smoother.

* The Grappling Hook throw animation now correctly follows up/down aim direction, and the dodge roll animation while attached has been smoothed out to remove visual popping.

# Audio

General

* Fixed the audio when opening and searching loot containers on the Frigate and inside the Emperor.

* Adjusted distance and air absorption settings for the Frigate engine and Frigate Cannon audio to improve how they sound over range.

* Adjusted blunt damage and debris impact sounds so they are louder and scale correctly.

* Fixed missing loot sounds on Transmitter Debris objects.

* Adjusted the Bombardier mortar firing audio so it is not excessively loud or close-sounding at long range.

* Polished Cassio's and Celeste's voice lines for better clarity and consistency.

* Added voice responses for the Cowboy emote.

Ballistic Gondola

* Fixed an issue where the Ballistic Gondola engine audio could cut out during takeoff; rocket sound now plays continuously.

* Extended the duration of the Ballistic Gondola takeoff preparation sound so it does not cut off when several players board one after another.

* Added distant variations of the Ballistic Gondola boarding and takeoff alarms to improve how distance and position are conveyed through audio.

* Polished the Ballistic Gondola door interaction sounds and fixed an issue where the door-open sound could play twice when entering and exiting.

# ARC

* Fixed an issue where certain ARC units had better-than-intended accuracy against sliding players; their aim now properly accounts for sliding targets.

* Fixed an issue where the Hydra's weapons weren't spreading across different targets as often as they should. Base damage has been increased to balance this fix, keeping its overall threat level competitive. Also fixed an issue where it struggled to hit targets at close range.

* ARC will now react when Gondola Transceivers are interacted with.

# Gameplay

Frigate

* Fixed an issue where players could be ejected from cargo while it was falling from the Frigate.

* Fixed an issue where riders on the side of a falling Frigate cargo drop could be instantly knocked out. Crushing damage now only applies at the landing point and to riders inside.

* Fixed an issue where Raiders riding a Frigate cargo drop could take burn damage during descent; thruster heat now only affects the area near landing.

Emperor

* Fixed an issue where moving platforms inside the Emperor could desync, improving reliability when riding or crossing them.

# Items

General

* Fixed an issue preventing Tether Launchers from being repaired mid-round.

* Fixed an issue where the Geometric Fabric Chair Design blueprint was not granted after being consumed.

Grappling Hook

* Improved the feel of rappelling to the ground with the Grappling Hook.

* Improved auto-vaulting from the Grappling Hook, with more reliable wall detection and better consistency on steep slopes.

* Improved swing and rope-climb entry near the ground:

* Climbing now continues briefly when a climb starts from the ground.

* Velocity toward the rope is preserved, so a jump from the ground carries momentum into the climb.

* Attaching to a rope on a steep slope now correctly triggers the wall-climb state.

* Fixed unintended landing behavior when climbing beneath an overhead rope.

# Maps

General

* Increased spawn consistency for ARC Turbines in Buried City, Riven Tides, Blue Gate and Spaceport. In sessions where they previously only had a chance to spawn, they should now appear in nearly all, if not all, sessions.

* Fixed visual culling issues affecting Frigate lighting in Buried City, Spaceport, and Blue Gate, and adjusted map boundaries near the Emperor to stop players from clipping out of bounds.

* Fixed coverage issues with the compaction killboxes inside the Emperor.

Pendola Pass

* Fixed a collision issue that allowed players to get stuck inside the Fallen Emperor.

* Slightly increased enemy presence.

* Improved lighting and reflections for better visual clarity across several weather conditions.

* Fixed an issue affecting a Ballistic Gondola's navigation through the Secure Communications Mast.

* Fixed floating objects as well as vegetation and snow clipping through walls.

* Fixed several spots where players could get stuck or fall through the terrain.

Dam Battlegrounds

* Removed ARC Turbine spawns from standard sessions and most minor map conditions. In the remaining conditions, they should now spawn in nearly all, if not all, sessions.

Stella Montis

* Improved lighting and reflections for better visual clarity and consistency across different times of day.

# Movement

* Jumping off a wall during a Wall Run now requires holding backward first, to help prevent accidental triggers.

* Enabled transitions from wall climbing into ladders and ziplines.

# Performance

* Reduced memory usage in loot spawning systems to improve stability during rounds.

* Optimized the Frigate entry sequence.

# Quest

* "To the Skies" can now be completed on any map regardless of where progress was made; players only need to finish the installation at one location to complete the quest.

* The "Belly of the Beast" optional objective now correctly requires the item described in its objective text.

# Stability

* Reduced memory usage in Frigate interiors to fix rare crashes while exploring the cargo hold.

* Improved Frigate stability by fixing a memory issue that could cause crashes while moving through its interior.

# UI

General

* Polished the lighting and reflections in the Main Menu for better visuals.

* Removed the Expedition Vault tab and its associated offer.

Quest

* Fixed an issue where focus could be lost when navigating the quest tracker using a gamepad.

Reward Pass

* Fixed an outdated Cred icon appearing in character customization for Reward Pass rewards.

* Feats rebalance: new Feats have been added, some existing ones removed, and others rebalanced to smooth out progression through the Reward Pass.

Outpost

* Fixed an issue where the Workshop screen could appear broken if the basic workbench was placed in the last available Outpost slot.

* The Raider is now hidden while inspecting or decorating furniture, and while viewing a bench's Generator screen, so the camera is no longer blocked.

* In the Inspect/Decorate view, camera rotation now requires holding the left mouse button; right-click dragging no longer changes camera pitch.

* Fixed an issue where the Inspect/Decorate camera could fade to black when orbiting close to walls.

Skill Tree

* Node tooltips now display how many levels a skill has, visible as long as the node hasn't been reached yet.

* Changed the wording from "Add Skill Point" to "Spend Point" to reduce confusion.

Weapon Amplification

* Updated the Weapon Bench upgrade tab so the button for amplified weapons now reads "Amplify" instead of "Ascend".

# VFX

* Fixed a visual issue where the Aphelion's beam effect could appear cut off.

* Improved explosion impact marks with higher-resolution visuals for clearer craters.

* Fixed an issue where weapon-firing smoke could disappear under certain conditions.

# Known Issues

* The Raider Tool shows its default skin even when a different skin is equipped.

* Extracting with partial progress on the "To The Skies" quest may prevent it from being completed later.

* In "When Everything Falls," some quest objectives, such as "Photograph Port A," may fail to complete for certain players.

* If players lose or sell quest items, such as the Equatorial Sundial needed for "Clean Hands," the quest may become impossible to complete.

* Players can still die after boarding the Ballistic Gondola if they are downed and very close to being knocked out.

* Some Xbox players may experience instability or crashes.

* The Grapple Hook can, in rare cases, launch the player using it upward at high speed.

* The Grapple Hook cannot be thrown while inside the Matriarch's shield.

* ARC Reclaimers can occasionally fail to dock at the correct spot on the Frigate.

See you Topside,

The ARC Raiders Team
